nodes.description: Main Storage.State struct holding epoch, balances, provider, peg and mappings for accounts, epochs and candidates
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy implementation address, written via assembly sstore
External advance() driving Bonding/Regulator/Market steps and minting the advance incentive to the caller via the incentivized modifier
External purchaseCoupons(uint256) burning caller dollars and minting coupons including premium
External redeemCoupons(uint256,uint256) burning penalty and transferring redeemable dollars to caller
External transferCoupons(address,address,uint256,uint256) moving coupon balances with allowance deduction
External deposit(uint256) pulling shares from the caller and crediting staged balance
External withdraw(uint256) returning staged shares to the caller
External claim(uint256) transferring claimable dollars to the caller
External bond(uint256) converting staged shares into bonded dollars and phantom balance
External unbond(uint256) converting bonded dollars back to staged/claimable balances
External vote(address,Candidate.Vote) recording governance votes weighted by bonded balance
External commit(address) that upgrades the proxy to an approved candidate implementation after quorum
External emergencyCommit(address) upgrading the proxy when a super majority exists and epoch is out of sync
External updatePegPrice(uint256) restricted to the peg regulator that writes the peg into storage
Public initializer performing the initial X and Z token distribution
msg.sender, the caller address used for authorization checks, balance credits and minting
block.timestamp, used for epoch computation and coupon redemption penalty decay
External call dollar().mint(...) minting new stablecoins to a target account
External call dollar().transfer(...) sending stablecoins to a recipient
External call dollar().transferFrom(...) pulling stablecoins from the caller before burning
External call share().transfer/transferFrom(...) moving share tokens in and out of the contract
delegatecall to the candidate implementation initialize() invoked from upgradeTo
External call oracle().capture() returning the current price used by the regulator
Amount of dollars supplied by the caller when purchasing coupons
Epoch of the coupons being redeemed or transferred
Amount of coupons to redeem
Source account of a coupon transfer
Destination account of a coupon transfer
Amount of coupons being transferred
Amount of shares supplied to deposit()
Amount of shares or dollars supplied to withdraw() and claim()
Candidate address voted for or used as the new implementation in commit flows
Penalty amount burned during coupon redemption
Net redeemable amount after subtracting the redemption penalty
Coupon amount minted to the purchaser, equal to dollarAmount plus premium

edges.reason: msg.sender receives the advance incentive minted inside the incentivized modifier
msg.sender is the coupon purchaser and source of burned dollars
msg.sender coupon balance is decremented and receives the redeemed dollars
msg.sender is compared with sender to decide whether the coupon allowance must be deducted
msg.sender is the depositor whose staged balance is credited
onlyFrozenOrLocked(msg.sender) gates the withdrawal
onlyFrozenOrLocked(msg.sender) gates the claim
onlyFrozenOrFluid(msg.sender) gates the bonding action
msg.sender is the account whose bonded position is reduced
onlyFrozenOrLocked(msg.sender) plus bonded balance check gates voting
commit is invoked by msg.sender which is emitted in the Commit event
emergencyCommit is invoked by msg.sender who triggers the upgrade
onlyPegRegulator compares msg.sender against the configured regulator address
Bonding.step epoch progression depends on block.timestamp through epochTime()
couponRedemptionPenalty derives penalty decay from block.timestamp
emergencyCommit checks epochTime() against epoch plus the emergency delay
incentivized modifier mints dollar tokens to msg.sender through an external mint call
burnFromAccount pulls the caller's dollars with an external transferFrom before burning
redeemToAccount performs an external dollar transfer to the caller
deposit performs an external share transferFrom from the caller
withdraw performs an external share transfer to the caller
commit upgrades the proxy via a delegatecall into the candidate implementation
emergencyCommit upgrades the proxy via a delegatecall into the candidate implementation
Regulator.step consumes the price returned by the external oracle capture call
updatePegPrice writes the new price into _state.peg via setPeg
dollarAmount determines how many coupons are minted and how many dollars are burned
couponEpoch selects the coupon balance to decrement and the penalty age
couponAmount is the amount decremented and passed to the redemption penalty calculation
sender is the account whose coupon balance and allowance are decremented
recipient is credited with the transferred coupons
amount is the coupon quantity moved between accounts
value is the share quantity transferred in and staged
value is the staged share quantity transferred back to the caller
value is the claimable dollar quantity transferred to the caller
candidate is the target of the recorded governance vote
candidate address is validated and used as the new implementation in commit
candidate address is validated and used as the new implementation in emergencyCommit
burnAmount computed by couponRedemptionPenalty is subtracted from couponAmount
redeemAmount is derived from couponAmount - burnAmount and passed to redeemToAccount
couponAmount is the sum of dollarAmount and its premium before being credited

normalization_plan.reason: dollarAmount only exists to drive the coupon purchase flow and should be folded into purchaseCoupons
couponEpoch parameter only selects the epoch used inside redeemCoupons
couponAmount parameter is only consumed by the redemption logic of redeemCoupons
sender parameter is only used as the source account inside transferCoupons
recipient parameter is only used as the destination account inside transferCoupons
amount parameter is only the transferred coupon quantity inside transferCoupons
deposit value parameter only feeds the staged balance update of deposit
value parameter is only consumed by withdraw for staged shares
candidate parameter is the implementation target validated and used by commit
burnAmount is a temporary penalty value only used within redeemCoupons
redeemAmount is a temporary net amount only used within redeemCoupons
couponAmount is a temporary minted quantity only used within purchaseCoupons
